main_text.l: QUID si ipsum audires Lector, sua verba tonantem, Cum jacit æterno fulmina digna Deo; Attonitosque trahit populos, & pectora mulcet, Eloquioque potens regnat, & astra quatit?
DALLÆUM nemo, DALLÆI, dicere posses, Vox superat calamum, solaque Lingua manum.
Attamen hoc præsto, Genium non defore chartis, Quæ de DALLÆI nomine nomen habent.
Maxima pars isto vel amœna effundimus ævo, Vel gravia & nullo tincta lepore damus:
Pagina DALLÆI quovis sub judice punctum Omne tulit, lepidum seu grave quæris opus;
Hic lepor occurrit, qualem decet esse virorum, Qualis & Angelico fulget in ore lepor:
Hic gravitas lato incedit perfusa sereno, Cœlesti gravitas convenit illa choro.
Triste supercilium procul hinc, procul omnis & horror, Barbariesque ipso pœnè superba situ:
Mollities tamen omnis abest, & luxus inermis Frangens

page.notes: The initial Q is a woodcut historiated initial, joined to "UID". Lines marked as verse are kept as printed paragraphs by stanza. Faint background text from the facing page is not transcribed. Some letters at the start of lines are ornamental and uncertain, notably the Q and the italic capitals, but they read as printed.
